newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen down on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen down on profit-taking.

text.p: The Warsaw bourse is expected to fall on Wednesday, extending Tuesday's dip as local players are seen taking profits on selected stocks after their gains last week and on Monday.
Analysts said in the longer-term the bourse was likely to maintain its 2.5-month sideways drift.
Construction and trading firm Atlantis SA starts bourse trade on the main market and analysts expect it to open be around its issue price of six zlotys.
